# Collisions

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** Collisions

## What it does

Adds collision boxes to certain blocks/areas.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/world/Collisions.java).
